He insisted that we could tackle this without surgery, and I’m so glad I trusted him—even when well-meaning friends and family suggested getting a second opinion.
He managed to treat me with medical intervention alone, without insisting on surgery or charging exorbitant fees. His honest approach made all the difference.
It was also a huge plus that Dr. Baghel has clinics in both Nallasopara and Vasai East, making it easy to get an appointment in case of an emergency. His staff were professional, accommodating, and quick to reschedule or book appointments based on my convenience. The added benefit of having access to KK Speciality Hospital, with its emergency room, provided peace of mind during those really tough times.
I am grateful for his expertise and care. If you’re dealing with bone or joint pain, book an appointment with Dr. Suraj Baghel—you’ll be in the best hands!

In the early stages, posture-related changes are usually flexible and improve with exercise, stretching, and posture correction. During the healing process, some patients may continue to feel tingling, burning sensations, mild numbness, or intermittent leg or arm pain. This does not always mean the surgery has failed. The speed of healing depends on factors such as the duration of nerve compression, overall health, diabetes, smoking, and the severity of the original condition.
